reason: A provides a substantially better-grounded, bounded, and falsifiable mechanism linking SFE, partial-dislocation separation, twinning, strain hardening, and toughness, with a defined baseline and controlled test series. Its claimed ~30 mJ/m² optimum and low-SFE phase-transition argument require validation and alloying may introduce confounders, but B is too unspecified and unsupported regarding the base alloy, metastable transformation, temperature regime, and why Nb precipitates would promote rather than degrade toughness.
